role: validation-only immutable transport for the already accepted exact Seller Swagger bytes; never production input

carrier.encoding: base64 with one canonical trailing LF
carrier.checkout_portability: CRLF is normalized to LF before carrier identity; decoded XZ and raw Swagger remain strict byte identities

authority.note: This carrier does not redefine Seller Swagger authority. It transports the already verified accepted exact bytes after live docs recovery became non-deterministic on GitHub runners.
